FN-EJR6UC2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 107
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Donna Givens
Security
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 107 as introduced would establish a new distinctive license plate for motor vehicle
owners who served in a component of the United States Armed Forces and received the Combat
Action Ribbon, Combat Infantryman Badge, Combat Action Badge, or Air Force Combat
Action Medal. The fee for the plate would be the same as for standard vehicles ($23) and there
would be an additional fee of $3 for each plate issued. The standard fee would be distributed as
follows:
State General Fund $10.00
Public Road and Bridge $9.30
Municipalities $2.52
Counties $1.18
Total $23.00
This bill would also establish s class C misdemeanor for falsely obtaining a military combat
action special license plate and could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds,
municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase
the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of this offense and
the penalties imposed.
